Package com.j3d.gen.docs.api

Class HeaderIdentifier

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.gen.docs.api.HeaderIdentifier
public class HeaderIdentifier extends Object
Represents a TWHeader within a DocsFrame's JTree. *

This class is used to identify a header within the help documentation, allowing for navigation and hierarchical representation in a JTree.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
